rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: PagerDuty's official MCP server that provides comprehensive access to PagerDuty's incident management platform through both read-only and write operations. Offers tools for managing incidents, services, teams, users, schedules, escalation policies, on-call rotations, event orchestrations, status pages, and alert grouping settings with safety annotations to distinguish between safe read operations and potentially destructive write operations. Built with Python using FastMCP and includes evaluation testing framework with LLM clients for OpenAI and AWS Bedrock, making it valuable for incident response automation, on-call management, service reliability workflows, and integrating PagerDuty operations into AI-powered DevOps processes.
